# Documentação das Telas e Rotas REST

## Tela: Login

![][image1]

### Rotas de Autenticação

#### 1. Login de usuário
- **Method:** `POST`
- **Path:** `/api/auth/login`
- **Summary:** Login a user
- **Request Body:**
  - `email` (string, required)
  - `password` (string, required)
- **Responses:**
  - `201`: User logged in successfully
  - `400`: Invalid credentials

#### 2. Logout de usuário
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/auth/logout`
- **Summary:** Logout a user
- **Responses:**
  - `201`: User logged out successfully
  - `400`: Bad request

## Tela: Cadastro de Usuário

![][image3]

### Rotas de Registro

#### 1. Registrar novo usuário
- **Method:** `POST`
- **Path:** `/api/auth/register`
- **Summary:** Register a new user
- **Request Body:**
  - `email` (string, required)
  - `password` (string, required)
  - `nickname` (string, required)
- **Responses:**
  - `201`: User registered successfully
  - `400`: Bad request

## Tela: Home

![][image5]

### Rotas de Postagens e Perfil

#### 1. Listar todas as postagens
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/posts`
- **Summary:** Get all posts
- **Responses:**
  - `200`: List of posts
  - `401`: Unauthorized

#### 2. Obter perfil do usuário autenticado
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/users/profile`
- **Summary:** Get authenticated user profile
- **Responses:**
  - `200`: User fetched successfully
  - `400`: Invalid credentials

## Tela: Criação de Post

![][image7]

### Rotas de Criação de Conteúdo

#### 1. Criar nova postagem
- **Method:** `POST`
- **Path:** `/api/posts`
- **Summary:** Create a new post
- **Request Body:**
  - `title` (string)
  - `content` (string)
  - `tags` (array of string)
  - `file` (array of binary)
- **Responses:**
  - `201`: Post created successfully
  - `400`: Bad request
  - `401`: Unauthorized

#### 2. Upload de arquivos para uma postagem
- **Method:** `POST`
- **Path:** `/api/files/{postId}`
- **Summary:** Upload files to a post
- **Parameters:**
  - `postId` (string, required): Post ID
- **Request Body:**
  - `file` (array of binary): Files to upload
- **Responses:**
  - `200`: Files uploaded successfully
  - `400`: Invalid post ID or no files provided
  - `403`: Not authorized to add files to this post
  - `404`: Post not found
  - `500`: Error submitting files

## Tela: Perfil

![][image9]

### Rotas de Usuário

#### 1. Obter usuário autenticado
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/users/profile`
- **Summary:** Get authenticated user profile
- **Responses:**
  - `200`: User fetched successfully
  - `400`: Invalid credentials

#### 2. Atualizar perfil do usuário
- **Method:** `PUT`
- **Path:** `/api/users/profile/settings`
- **Summary:** Update user profile
- **Request Body:**
  - `nickname` (string)
  - `degree` (string)
  - `file` (binary): Profile picture
- **Responses:**
  - `200`: User updated successfully
  - `400`: Bad request
  - `404`: User not found

## Tela: Exibir Post

![][image13]

### Rota de Detalhamento de Post

#### 1. Obter postagem por ID
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/posts/{id}`
- **Summary:** Get post by ID
- **Parameters:**
  - `id` (string, required): Post ID
- **Responses:**
  - `200`: Post fetched successfully
  - `401`: Unauthorized
  - `404`: Post not found

## Tela: Baixar Material

![][image15]

### Rota de Download de Arquivo

#### 1. Download de arquivo
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/files/download/{id}`
- **Summary:** Download a file
- **Parameters:**
  - `id` (string, required): File ID
- **Responses:**
  - `200`: File downloaded successfully
  - `404`: File not found

## Tela: Exibir Minhas Postagens

![][image17]

### Rotas de Listagem de Postagens de Usuário

#### 1. Posts por ID de usuário
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/users/profile/id/{userId}/posts`
- **Summary:** Get posts by user ID
- **Parameters:**
  - `userId` (string, required): User ID
- **Responses:**
  - `200`: Posts fetched successfully
  - `400`: Invalid user ID
  - `404`: User or posts not found

#### 2. Posts por nickname de usuário
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/users/profile/nickname/{nickname}/posts`
- **Summary:** Get posts by user nickname
- **Parameters:**
  - `nickname` (string, required): User nickname
- **Responses:**
  - `200`: Posts fetched successfully
  - `404`: User or posts not found
